dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin, it’s April 20.

The dog-themed digital currency that was started as a joke in 2013 jumped more than 200% in five days as part of a meme-driven mass trade to mark International Weed Day.

It has already fallen back by 24%. https://t.co/rCXRp5iM6L

Bitcoin may be facing a make-or-break moment.

Rebounded above its average price over the past 100 days, it’s still trading below its 50-day moving average (about $57,042).

Dogecoin has shot up in price thanks to memes https://t.co/uXoV3IvLPP
